purpose.zh: 练大腿前侧和腹部抬腿的耐力，腿能扫得过去
purpose.en: Builds the hip and belly strength to lift and sweep your legs through.

text.zh: 挂在杠上先把肩往下压，腿并拢伸直抬到和地面平
text.en: Pull your shoulders down on the bar, then lift your straight legs together to level

text.zh: 腿抬起来的时候屁股往后坐一点，身体别前后晃。
text.en: As your legs come up, let your hips go back a little, and keep your body from swinging.

text.zh: 抬到平停一秒，再用三秒慢慢放下来，放到底先停稳再抬下一个。
text.en: Wait a second at level, take three seconds to lower, and settle at the bottom before the next one.

text.zh: 直腿抬不到平，就先屈膝抬。
text.en: If straight legs don't reach level yet, lift with bent knees.

commonErrors.en: Swinging back and forth for momentum.

commonErrors.zh: 只抬到一半就放，或者放得太快
commonErrors.en: Stopping halfway up, or dropping the legs too fast.

commonErrors.zh: 肩膀松了，整个人挂在杠上耸着肩
commonErrors.en: Letting your shoulders go loose and hanging with them up by your ears.

cautions.zh: 手握不住就先做屈膝版，组数少一点
cautions.en: If your grip gives out, do the bent-knee version and fewer sets.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (8 s per rep: raise 1.6 s, hold 1 s, lower 3 s, still hang 2.4 s; brief: 停 1 秒，3 秒控制放下)

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 9 后侧支撑 / 12 第一侧换腿
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 8 s (raise 1.6 s, hold 1 s, lower 3 s, still hang 2.4 s).
